I searched the REST module with one grep and didn't open the files, so the line ranges below are single call-site lines, not whole methods. The production code that calls `UserService.getUserByUuid` is in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`. Each path starts with `omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/`.

- **`UserResource1_8` (line 209):** the user resource looks up a user by UUID.
- **`UserConverter1_8` (line 36):** converts a UUID string into a `User`. Any resource that references a user by UUID goes through it.
- **`ProviderSearchHandler1_9` (line 56):** resolves the user UUID when searching for providers.
- **`AlertRecipientResource2_0` (line 88):** resolves the recipient UUID.
- **`ChangePasswordController1_8` (line 74):** resolves the user whose password is being changed.

Test classes also call it (for example `UserController1_8Test`, `UserController2_0Test`, `PasswordResetController2_2Test` and the alert tests). They would break if the behaviour changed, but I left them out of the list below.
